meta_analysis.verdict: MIXED / WITHIN-DOMAIN ONLY (not a robust integration win): the tox21-pretrained embedding helps only where the outcome is closest to its toxicity training domain (per-outcome ΔC−A: clintox -0.0113, skin_reaction +0.0627, carcinogens_lagunin +0.0016); mean ΔC−A +0.0177 across 3 outcomes, and the embedding ALONE is generally WORSE than structure (mean ΔB−A -0.1119). So the learned representation shows genuine WITHIN-DOMAIN transfer (e.g. skin_reaction) but does NOT robustly beat raw structure across held-out outcomes — consistent with the information-bottleneck: a shallow learned representation over Morgan+physchem adds nothing general beyond raw structure. A robust integration win would need a much larger deep molecular foundation model (beyond torch-free shallow MLP) — the honest boundary.

provenance.representation: sklearn MLPClassifier hidden=(256, 64) multi-task on tox21 (12 assays); embedding=last hidden
